title: Phrasal verbs and collocations
grammar: Separable and inseparable phrasal verbs, collocations

phases.name: Presentation
phases.content: In this unit you will learn phrasal verbs and collocations, key for natural English at B2 level.

phases.name: Discovery
phases.content: Read these sentences. Please turn off the light. Please turn the light off. I ran into an old friend. Notice: some phrasal verbs are separable (turn off), some are not (run into).

phases.name: Guided practice
phases.prompt: I ___ my old teacher at the supermarket yesterday.
phases.explanation: Run into means to meet by chance.

phases.name: Free practice
phases.prompt: Write 5 sentences using phrasal verbs you have learned recently.

phases.name: Mini-test
phases.prompt: We have ___ milk. Can you buy some?
phases.explanation: Run out of means to have no more of something.
